```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
is_lrt <- isTRUE(params$run_args$analysis_mode == "lrt") ||
  identical(params$viper_out$tf_level, "lrt_cluster")
has_cluster_tf <- is_lrt && !is.null(params$viper_out) &&
  length(params$viper_out$contrast_acts) > 0
has_wald_tf <- !is_lrt && !is.null(params$viper_out) &&
  length(params$viper_out$contrast_acts) > 0
```

## VIPER protein activity (bcellViper)

```{r viper-intro, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$viper_out)}
cat("\n\nMaster-regulator / protein activity inferred with ",
    "[**VIPER**](https://califano.c2b2.columbia.edu/viper) ",
    "(`viper` / `msviper`) using the human B-cell transcriptional regulon from the ",
    "[**bcellViper**](https://bioconductor.org/packages/bcellViper/) data package ",
    "(Alvarez et al., *Nat Genet* 2016). Detected organism: **",
    params$viper_out$org, "**",
    if (identical(params$viper_out$org, "mouse")) {
      " (mouse genes mapped to human orthologs via `babelgene` before scoring)."
    } else {
      "."
    },
    " Regulons loaded: **", params$viper_out$regulon_n, "**.\n\n",
    "Sample-level scores use gene-wise z-scored VST expression with `viper()`. ",
    if (is_lrt) {
      paste0("Cluster-level master-regulator analysis uses each degPatterns ",
             "cluster's LRT `stat` signature with `msviper()`.")
    } else {
      paste0("Contrast-level master-regulator analysis uses each comparison's ",
             "DESeq2 Wald `stat` as the gene-expression signature with `msviper()`, ",
             "and the classic VIPER barcode plot (`plot.msviper`) shows ",
             "positively/negatively regulated targets in red/blue along the ranked signature.")
    },
    "\n\n",
    sep = "")
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce VIPER with this package module:",
  "viper_out <- run_viper_pipeline(",
  "  dds_qc, var = \"condition\", diffexp_out = diffexp_out",
  ")"
)
```

```{r viper-missing, results='asis', eval=is.null(params$viper_out)}
cat("\n\nVIPER analysis was not run for this report ",
    "(`run_viper = FALSE` or `viper_out = NULL`).\n\n")
```

### Sample-level VIPER activities

```{r viper-sample-heat, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$viper_out$sample_heatmap)}
n_heat <- params$viper_out$n_tfs_heatmap
if (is.null(n_heat)) n_heat <- 50
cat("\n\nTop **", n_heat,
    "** most variable TFs / master regulators across samples ",
    "(rows = samples, columns = TFs; scores scaled per sample). ",
    "Dark blue = inactive, red = active.\n\n", sep = "")

hm <- params$viper_out$sample_heatmap
gt <- hm$gtable
native_w <- min(grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 10)
native_h <- min(grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 10)
disp_w <- 0.5 * min(native_w, 6.5) * 1.25
disp_h <- 0.5 * min(native_h, 5)
dpi <- 150
pixelratio <- dpi / 72
css_w <- as.integer(round(native_w * 72))
css_h <- as.integer(round(native_h * 72))
display_w <- as.integer(round(disp_w * dpi))
display_h <- as.integer(round(disp_h * dpi))
img <- htmltools::plotTag({
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(gt)
}, alt = "viper_sample_heatmap", width = css_w, height = css_h, pixelratio = pixelratio,
   suppressSize = "xy",
   attribs = list(
     width = display_w, height = display_h,
     style = sprintf("max-width: none !important; width: %dpx; height: %dpx;", display_w, display_h)
   ))
sample_df <- data.frame(
  tf = rownames(params$viper_out$sample_acts),
  params$viper_out$sample_acts,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
buttons <- list(
  deseq2reports::download_grid_plot_button(hm, filename = "viper_sample_tf_heatmap",
                                           width = 0.5 * native_w, height = 0.5 * native_h),
  deseq2reports::link_output_file("viper_sample_activities.csv", label = "Download sample activities CSV")
)
deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(img, buttons))
```

```{r viper-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_viper_contrast <- function(comp, msv, acts, n_tfs, cluster_mode = FALSE) {
  cat("\n\nmsVIPER master regulators for this ",
      if (cluster_mode) "temporal cluster (LRT `stat` signature)"
      else "contrast (DESeq2 Wald `stat` signature)",
      ". Barcode plot shows the top **", n_tfs,
      "** regulators by p-value (red/blue = positively/negatively regulated targets ",
      "along the ranked gene list; layout from `plot.msviper`).\n\n", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(msv)) {
    deseq2reports::emit_msviper_plot(
      msv, filename = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", comp), "_msviper_barcode"),
      mrs = n_tfs, width = 4, height = max(2, 0.175 * n_tfs + 0.75), dpi = 150
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(acts) && nrow(acts) > 0) {
    show <- acts[order(acts$p.value), , drop = FALSE]
    show <- utils::head(show, 50L)
    btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
      file.path(comp, "msviper_contrast.csv"),
      label = "Download full CSV"
    )
    deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
      deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(show, page_length = 15), btn
    )
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}

specs <- NULL
if (!is.null(params$diffexp_out) && !is_lrt) {
  specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
  if (is.null(specs) && !is.null(params$viper_out$contrast_acts)) {
    comps <- names(params$viper_out$contrast_acts)
    specs <- data.frame(
      label = comps,
      class = "single",
      type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
      stratum_var = NA_character_,
      stratum_level = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
if (!is.null(specs) && !is.null(params$viper_out$contrast_acts)) {
  specs <- specs[specs$label %in% names(params$viper_out$contrast_acts), , drop = FALSE]
}
two_factor <- !is.null(specs) && any(specs$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))

cluster_tf_labels <- if (has_cluster_tf) {
  names(params$viper_out$contrast_acts)
} else {
  character(0)
}
```

```{r viper-cluster-heading, results='asis', eval=has_cluster_tf}
cat("\n\n### Master regulators by temporal cluster\n\n")
```

```{r viper-cluster, results='asis', eval=has_cluster_tf}
n_tfs <- params$viper_out$n_tfs
cat("\n\nmsVIPER master regulators for each **degPatterns** cluster ",
    "(signature = LRT `stat` of cluster members). Use the tabs to inspect ",
    "one cluster at a time.\n\n", sep = "")
short_labs <- sub("^.* cluster ", "cluster ", cluster_tf_labels)
if (anyDuplicated(short_labs) || any(!nzchar(short_labs))) {
  short_labs <- cluster_tf_labels
}
pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("viper-lrt-clusters", short_labs)
for (i in seq_along(cluster_tf_labels)) {
  comp <- cluster_tf_labels[i]
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
  emit_viper_contrast(
    comp,
    params$viper_out$contrast_msviper[[comp]],
    params$viper_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
    n_tfs,
    cluster_mode = TRUE
  )
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
}
deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
```

```{r viper-contrast-heading, results='asis', eval=has_wald_tf}
cat("\n\n### Contrast-level msVIPER\n\n")
```

```{r viper-contrast-single, results='asis', eval=has_wald_tf && !two_factor}
vp_pairwise <- specs$label[specs$type == "pairwise"]
vp_one_vs_all <- specs$label[specs$type == "one_vs_all"]
n_tfs <- params$viper_out$n_tfs

cat("\n\n#### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(vp_pairwise) > 0) {
  for (comp in vp_pairwise) {
    cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_viper_contrast(comp,
                        params$viper_out$contrast_msviper[[comp]],
                        params$viper_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                        n_tfs)
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
}

cat("\n\n#### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(vp_one_vs_all) > 0) {
  for (comp in vp_one_vs_all) {
    cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_viper_contrast(comp,
                        params$viper_out$contrast_msviper[[comp]],
                        params$viper_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                        n_tfs)
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo one-vs-all comparisons.\n\n")
}
```

```{r viper-contrast-two-factor, results='asis', eval=has_wald_tf && two_factor}
var <- params$var
n_tfs <- params$viper_out$n_tfs
for (cls in c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction")) {
  sub <- specs[specs$class == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  title <- deseq2reports::contrast_class_title(cls, var)
  cat("\n\n#### ", title, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(cls, "interaction")) {
    has_sub <- "coef_subtract" %in% names(sub)
    is_pw <- if (has_sub) {
      !is.na(sub$coef_subtract) & nzchar(as.character(sub$coef_subtract))
    } else {
      rep(FALSE, nrow(sub))
    }
    ref_labs <- sub$label[!is_pw]
    pw_labs <- sub$label[is_pw]

    if (length(ref_labs) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n##### Vs reference {.tabset}\n\n")
      for (comp in ref_labs) {
        cat("\n\n###### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_viper_contrast(comp,
                            params$viper_out$contrast_msviper[[comp]],
                            params$viper_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                            n_tfs)
      }
    }
    if (length(pw_labs) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n##### Pairwise (non-reference) {.tabset}\n\n")
      for (comp in pw_labs) {
        cat("\n\n###### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_viper_contrast(comp,
                            params$viper_out$contrast_msviper[[comp]],
                            params$viper_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                            n_tfs)
      }
    }
    next
  }

  strata <- unique(sub$stratum_level)
  for (st in strata) {
    cat("\n\n##### ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    st_sub <- sub[sub$stratum_level == st, , drop = FALSE]
    ordered <- c(st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "pairwise"],
                 st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "one_vs_all"])
    for (comp in ordered) {
      cat("\n\n###### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_viper_contrast(comp,
                          params$viper_out$contrast_msviper[[comp]],
                          params$viper_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                          n_tfs)
    }
  }
}
```
